title: What the relay learned becomes the next head start.
sub: Every leg's handoff package, open question and final judgment settles into an FAQ and a vector index. Later legs retrieve the closest memories by meaning — each with its source, one click back to the task.
search_placeholder: Ask: how do we write titles without repeating ourselves?
empty: No knowledge yet. Finish a relay and choose “Save to knowledge” on the task.
ingest_1: On a leg's approval, the package is distilled into FAQ candidates.
ingest_2: Similarity > 0.92 merges; a squad owner publishes before it counts.
ingest_3: A repeated open question auto-creates a task or graduates into an FAQ.
retrieve_1: At dispatch, the top 5 are injected into the leg brief with citations.
retrieve_2: Squad first, workspace second; never across workspaces.
note: Only published entries are retrievable; drafts stay on this page.
deposit_sub: Turn this relay's handoff packages into one summary document and FAQ drafts. Published entries are retrieved by later legs.
